title: Scoped research price consumption contract
description: Stored in SourceMetadata.field_semantics[field].consumption. Not a financial qualification or external certificate. The consumer independently pins source_id/data_version; semantic judgments belong to evidence producers, not source-name routing or price similarity.

data_version.description: Version-bound artifact or snapshot identity, never the provider name alone.

field.description: Must exactly equal the field_semantics mapping key and consumed column.

unit.description: Exact economic unit. Unknown units cannot authorize a unit-sensitive consumer.

adjustment_policy.description: NONE for observed raw; an explicit recipe identity for adjusted research. NOT_APPLICABLE for quantities; UNKNOWN never passes.

adjustment_event_dates.description: Raw contracts cannot contain adjustment events. An explicit cutoff also rejects later event dates, using the existing conservative date-only timestamp convention.

scope.description: Inclusive observation-date ranges. Exactly one scope must cover each consumed security/date, including rows whose prices are missing. Split mixed bases into distinct scoped objects. Stable historical issuer identity remains subject to existing identity admission.

available_at.description: Evidence-backed information-availability upper bound for the entire scoped object. Null means UNKNOWN, not observation date or acquisition time. An explicit consumer cutoff rejects null or later bounds.

qualification.description: Research use only; never promotes PIT/HFQ/formal/execution financial admission.

evidence.description: Version-bound evidence locators or hashes, prepared upstream; no archive reads on consumption.
